newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 19.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* General Electric's NBC remained on top of the primetime Nielsen's television ratings for March 10-16.
* Walt Disney's ABC unveiled its development slate for the 1997-98 season to media buyers and scheduled its midseason replacement series Soul Man.
* "Jungle 2 Jungle" director John Pasquin has signed a deal to develop "First Gentleman" as a directing project with Witt-Thomas Films at Time Warner's Warner Bros.
* Writer Michael Blake and director William Morgan rolled out screenplay plans for a Western murder mystery and their new independent film company.

* Disney's Buena Vista was the big winner Monday night at Variety's EDI Reel Awards, with five statues for its $100 million-plus 1996 releases and a special award for three consecutive billion-dollar-grossing years.
